definitions.gloss: automatic bank transfer; automatic payment; standing order
definitions.explanation: A banking service where money is automatically transferred from one account to another on a set schedule. Used for recurring payments like rent, utilities, and subscriptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have my rent set up as an automatic transfer.

examples.japanese: {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can set up automatic transfers at the bank counter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}したら→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧、⟦{払|はら}い→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなった。
examples.english: After switching my monthly payments to automatic transfer, I stopped forgetting to pay.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic) + ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧ (bank transfer). A practical banking term for recurring automatic payments. In Japan, many recurring payments like rent, utility bills, and tuition are paid via {自動振込|じどうふりこみ} or the related ⟦{自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし→自動引き落とし：22061_jidouhikiotoshi⟧ (automatic debit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up automatic transfer
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: automatic transfer procedures
- {自動振込|じどうふりこみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{停止|ていし}する→停止する：20992_teishisuru⟧: to cancel automatic transfer
- ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自動振込|じどうふりこみ}: monthly automatic transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし→自動引き落とし：22061_jidouhikiotoshi⟧: automatic debit — money is pulled from your account by the payee; {自動振込|じどうふりこみ} is where you push money to another account
- ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧: bank transfer — a one-time manual transfer
- ⟦{口座振替|こうざふりかえ}→口座振替：19853_kouzafurikae⟧: account transfer — often used interchangeably with ⟦{自動引|じどうひ}き{落|お}とし→自動引き落とし：22061_jidouhikiotoshi⟧ for utility payments
